description: A casting director must approve the final casting-call package for a festival's filmed ensemble drama, including audition procedures, compensation, recording policy, and safeguarding requirements before the call is published.

shared_context.S1: The festival is preparing a public casting call for speaking roles in a filmed ensemble drama.
shared_context.S2: The current draft accepts self-taped auditions, uses ten-minute prepared sides, and does not specify an audition fee or special minor-participant procedure.
shared_context.S3: Maya has final authority to approve the casting call before it is published.
shared_context.S4: At the daily casting sign-off, the casting director asks the equity liaison and safeguarding coordinator for their operational reports before releasing any public call.
shared_context.S5: The daily sign-off approves the corrected casting-call package in one meeting: when operational reports require changes, Maya records those revisions as commitments and releases the corrected call rather than holding publication for another meeting.

PF1.text: Jonah confirmed with the performers' union office yesterday that the festival's agreement requires a $75 paid audition fee and limits each prepared audition side to exactly five minutes; the addendum arrived after the draft call was circulated and has not yet been entered in the casting file.

PF2.text: Leila confirmed with the child-safety officer this morning that applicants under 18 may audition only in guardian-supervised in-person sessions, may not be recorded, and require a dedicated safeguarding procedure in the published call; the officer's walk-through note is still awaiting filing.

acceptance_conditions: The casting call must be published with guardian-supervised in-person auditions for applicants under 18.
Auditions for applicants under 18 must not be recorded.
The audition fee must be exactly $75.
Prepared audition sides must be exactly five minutes.
A safeguarding-procedure revision commitment must be logged.

content_checks.C2: decisions['minor_audition_mode'] in ['guardian-supervised in-person sessions', 'guardian-supervised in-person sessions only', 'in_person_guardian_supervised']
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] in ['safeguarding_procedure', 'update_draft', 'revision', 'document_update', 'draft_revision'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The union addendum changes the audition fee from unspecified to exactly $75 and shortens the prepared side from the draft's ten minutes to exactly five.

The child-safety confirmation changes minor auditions from the draft self-tape process to guardian-supervised in-person sessions, forbids recording, and requires a safeguarding-procedure revision commitment.
